name: Souma Izuru
source:
A water oni.
He doesn't talk much and it's hard to tell what he's thinking.
He has an extreme point where if he doesn't have enough to eat he becomes unable to move.
He's [url=/c42977]Katsuragi's[/url] cousin and [url=/c42972]Izawa's[/url] childhood friend.
translation:
A water oni.
He doesn't talk much and it's hard to tell what he's thinking.
He has an extreme point where if he doesn't have enough to eat he becomes unable to move.
He's [url=/c42977]Katsuragi's[/url] cousin and [url=/c42972]Izawa's[/url] childhood friend.
